parsed.rationale: Both `app:WatchXYC` (WXYC/WatchXYC/PlayerPage.swift:210) and `app:iOS` (WXYC/iOS/NowPlayingWidget/Extensions.swift:47) define an identical `SwiftUI.Image.background` computed property, flagged as `function-duplicates-exact` with no restraint markers (all context flags false). The duplication is purely structural with no test, mock, codegen, or sample-app justification. The canonical home should be a shared extensions file — ideally a new `WXYC/Shared/Extensions/Image+Background.swift` or within an existing shared module both targets already depend on — so both targets can import a single definition. The copy in `PlayerPage.swift` is particularly misplaced since it mixes a view-level file with a utility extension.
